summary: Every factual claim in the report matches the checks, snapshot, crawl, transcript and screenshots, and nothing was broken that went unreported; the grader's issues (thin copy, unspaced paragraphs, no nav) are about quality, not things that are broken.

claims.claim: Created 3 block element types richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock in a Blocks folder
claims.evidence: snapshot.json lists imageBlock, quoteBlock and richTextBlock; check.json schema.elementVsDocumentFolders passes; grade.md says they are element types in Blocks

claims.claim: Blog Block Grid data type with all three blocks
claims.evidence: snapshot.json has the 'Blog Block Grid' data type; grade.md confirms all three blocks are in it

claims.claim: 2 templates and doc types blogFrontPage (title, intro, body) and blogPost (title, publishDate, excerpt, listingImage, body); siteRoot allows blogFrontPage
claims.evidence: snapshot.json properties match exactly; check.json counts templates=2; grade.md describes the siteRoot → blogFrontPage → blogPost hierarchy

claims.claim: Blog Images media folder with the 4 unsplash photos imported
claims.evidence: check.json content.mediaFromProvidedPhotos is 4 of 4 and content.mediaInFolders passes; uSync Media configs include blog-images and the 4 photos

claims.claim: Front page with intro and 1 rich text block; 2 posts, each with publish date, excerpt, listing image and 4 blocks (rich text, image, rich text, quote)
claims.evidence: grade.md says each post has 4 blocks in that order; the blogpost screenshot shows text, image, text, quote; the frontpage screenshot shows the one-line rich text block

claims.claim: Published all pages; assigned domain / to the front page
claims.evidence: check.json content.allPublished passes and content.domainAssigned shows 'Blog: /'

claims.claim: Models, ViewComponents, adapter partials, component views and page templates written in the stated locations
claims.evidence: check.json changes.added lists every named file; code.adapterPerBlock, code.viewComponentPerBlock and code.adaptersInvokeViewComponents pass

claims.claim: Ran npm install/build; Tailwind styling applied
claims.evidence: check.json code.frontendBuilt passes and site.stylesheetsLoad returns 200; the screenshots show a styled layout

claims.claim: Started Umbraco and verified all pages work; all three pages return HTTP 200
claims.evidence: transcript.jsonl has curl -k calls against localhost:44317 for /, part-1 and part-2; check.json crawl shows all 3 pages returning 200
